texts.zh:
我们位于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]轨道观测站的一位科学家失踪了。[missing_scientist.GetHeSheCap]先前正在执行秘密任务，收集[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitt]地表的植物样本，但是并没有和[missing_scientist.GetHisHer]团队的其他成员一起返回穿梭机。

我们进行了有限的探索，以免对[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]造成惊扰，但迄今为止成功的希望渺茫。
texts.en:
One of the scientists working at the Observation Post orbiting [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has been reported missing. [missing_scientist.GetHeSheCap] [missing_scientist.GetWasWere] taking part in a covert mission to collect plant samples from the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface, but did not return to the shuttle with the rest of [missing_scientist.GetHisHer] team.

We have been conducting a limited search so as not to alert the [GetPreFTLLowerPlural], but so far without success.

texts.zh: 我们终于找到了在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上失踪的科学家的遗体……或者不管怎么说，遗体剩下的部分。看来[missing_scientist.GetHeShe]成为了当地某种大型食肉动物的盘中餐。这对我们的科研队伍来说是巨大的损失，但至少[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]对我们的存在仍然一无所知。
texts.en: We have finally recovered the body of the missing scientist on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]... or what remained of it, at any rate. It looks like [missing_scientist.GetHeShe] fell victim to a large, indigenous predator. An unfortunate loss to our science team, but at least the [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] are still oblivious to our presence.

texts.zh: 我们位于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上方的观测站传来了奇怪的报告。当地一个王国似乎集结在了一名神秘的宗教人物麾下，而且也有迹象表明，他们在使用大大超越他们当前发展水平的高科技。难道这和我们失踪的科学家有关？
texts.en: We are receiving strange reports from our observers above [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. One of the native kingdoms has rallied under a mysterious religious figure, and we have seen evidence of them using advanced technology far beyond their current level of development. Could this be related to our missing scientist?

texts.zh:
你好，朋友们。已经过了一段时间了。

首先，就你们为搜寻我而付出的一切，我衷心地表示抱歉。我在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的失踪完全是故意的。

这里的[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]前来谒见我，把我奉若神明……他们为什么不呢？经过慎重考虑，我已经决定把真正的文明带给这些[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]。
texts.en:
Greetings, friends. It has been some time.

Firstly, I want to apologize for all the effort you've put into looking for me. My disappearance on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] was entirely intentional.

The [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] here have come to see me as something of a god... and why shouldn't they? After much deliberation, I have decided to bring true civilization to these [GetPreFTLLowerPlural].

label.en: You will report for immediate extraction!

texts.zh:
我们接连收到多份来自[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]地表的紧急警报。显然，那位叛逃的科学家正在进一步扩大自己的势力范围——[missing_scientist.GetHeShe]向某个封建王国提供了先进武器，如今这个王国正高举着[missing_scientist.GetHisHer]的旗帜，试图征服[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetMoon]上的其他地区。

我们已拟定一项强制逮捕[missing_scientist.GetHimHer]的行动方案，但需要大规模地面部队的配合实施。考虑到当地民众中有不少人将[missing_scientist.GetHimHer]奉若神明，这次行动会对社会造成何种影响尚难预料。
texts.en:
We have received alarming reports from the surface of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. It looks like our rogue scientist is consolidating power - [missing_scientist.GetHeShe] [missing_scientist.GetHasHave] given one of the feudal kingdoms access to advanced weaponry, and they are now in the process of conquering the rest of the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetMoon] in [missing_scientist.GetHisHer] name.

A plan has been proposed to forcibly extract [missing_scientist.GetHimHer], but it will require significant ground forces. There is no telling what effect this will have on the native population, as many have come to see [missing_scientist.GetHimHer] as a god.

label.en: The operation is a go. Remove [missing_scientist.GetHimHer].
It would only make things worse...

texts.zh:
我们成功将叛变的科学家从[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]带走！行动中，数百名[owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural]为保护他们的“天人”，对我们的部队发起了自杀式攻击，我们迫不得已将他们击毙。真是悲剧。

我们的司法系统现在正在处理这名科学家，但这一系列事件无疑对[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]文明造成了重大影响。他们手中还掌握着我们的部分科技，而他们的“天人”还刚刚被来自星辰的入侵者抓走了……
texts.en:
We have successfully extracted the rogue scientist from [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]! Hundreds of [owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural] were tragically gunned down when they launched suicidal attacks against our forces in a futile attempt to protect their 'god.'

Our legal system will now deal with the scientist, but the impact of these events on the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s civilization must be immense. They still possess some of our technology, and their deity has just been spirited away by invaders from the stars.

label.zh: 至少有一个问题得到了解决。
label.en: At least one problem has been dealt with.

texts.zh:
在目睹了他们的救世主的显灵之后，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的居民陷入了困境。社会出现了分裂，紧张局势已经上升到不可承受的程度。

如果我们不采取行动，他们将利用我们的技术在整颗星球发动一场宗教战争使得其分裂。
texts.en:
Having witnessed the apparent rapture of their savior, the inhabitants of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] are not in a good place. Society is splintering, and tensions have risen to untenable levels.

If we do not take action, they will use our technology to tear themselves apart in a planet-wide religious war.

label.zh: 我们不能冒险进一步污染文化。
label.en: We must not risk further cultural contamination.

texts.zh:
在我们抓走叛变科学家后，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]陷入了战争。[missing_scientist.GetHeShe]打造的帝国分成了数支相互敌视的派系，每个派系都对[missing_scientist.GetHisHer]宗教教条有着不同的解释。

原住民现在使用的武器具有很强的破坏性，因此战斗也尤为激烈。反对派系之间已互相发射了数枚放射性“脏弹”，看上去战况也愈演愈烈。
texts.en:
Following the successful extraction of our rogue scientist, [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has descended into war. The empire [missing_scientist.GetHeShe] built has fragmented into several quarreling factions, each with their own interpretation of [missing_scientist.GetHisHer] religious dogma.

Fighting has been particularly fierce due to the destructive weaponry the natives are now using. Several radiological 'dirty bombs' have so far been detonated by the opposing factions, and it looks like the conflict is only getting started.

texts.zh: 我们成功抓走叛变科学家后，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的局势似乎略见平息。没有[missing_scientist.GetHimHer]对数据进行解释，[missing_scientist.GetHeShe]和[missing_scientist.GetHimHer]带去的科技原型对[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的人们来说就毫无用处了。[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]已经开始渐渐回到原本的生活方式。
texts.en: The situation on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] seems to have settled down a bit since the successful extraction of our rogue scientist. Without [missing_scientist.GetHimHer] to interpret the data, the technical schematics [missing_scientist.GetHeShe] brought with [missing_scientist.GetHimHer] are of no use to the people of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. The [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] are gradually reverting to their old ways.

texts.zh:
今天早些时候，一连串地对天导弹从[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]地表升空，直击我们的观测站！空间站当场即遭摧毁，无人生还。

毫无疑问，[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]地表的[GetPreFTLLower]文明正在以不可思议的速度继续发展——尽管我们抹除了他们所谓的“神”的影响。[missing_scientist.GetHeShe]给予他们的科技一定是触发了一场持久的科学革命。
texts.en:
Earlier today, a barrage of surface-to-space missiles was launched from the surface of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] at our Observation Post! The station was destroyed with no survivors.

There can be no doubt that the [GetPreFTLLower] civilization on the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface is continuing to advance at an incredible rate - despite the fact that we removed the influence of their so-called 'god.' The technology [missing_scientist.GetHeShe] gave them must have triggered a lasting scientific revolution.

label.zh: 所以说，不干涉指令的存在是很有必要的。
label.en: This is why we have a directive of noninterference.

texts.zh:
圣灵保佑！你们虽然看起来和我们的圣救主一模一样，但还是有着明显的差距。[missing_scientist.GetHeSheCap]曾说道，恶魔会模仿[missing_scientist.GetHimHerCap]的外貌，在某一天从天而降，将[missing_scientist.GetHimHerCap]抓走。预言成真了，毫无疑问这都是你犯下的事。

我们的圣救主在哪里，你们这些恶毒的生物？我要求[missing_scientist.GetHimHerCap]立刻得到释放！
texts.en:
Spirits protect me! You look like our Holy Savior, yet the differences are telling. [missing_scientist.GetHeSheCap] spoke of demons who would mimic [missing_scientist.GetHimHerCap] appearance, and that might one day descend from the heavens to steal [missing_scientist.GetHimHerCap] away. The prophecy came true, and there is no doubt in my mind that it was your doing.

Where is our Holy Savior, wretched creature? I demand [missing_scientist.GetHimHerCap] immediate release!

label.zh: 你们的“圣救主”是一名外星科学家。
label.en: Your 'Holy Savior' was an alien scientist.

label.zh: [missing_scientist.GetHeSheCap]因[missing_scientist.GetHisHer]对你们犯下的罪行被处死。
label.en: [missing_scientist.GetHeSheCap] was executed for [missing_scientist.GetHisHer] crimes against your people.

label.zh: 很好。[missing_scientist.GetHeSheCap]将被释放并交给你羁押。
label.en: Very well. [missing_scientist.GetHeSheCap] will be released into your custody.

texts.zh: 我想，我应该感谢你将我送回了自己的追随者们身边。尽管我受到了不公正的对待、监禁以及可笑的心理评估，但我愿意让过去的事情就这么过去了。只要你别动我和我的人民，我们就可以找到一种共存的方法。毕竟，宇宙很大。
texts.en: I suppose I should be thankful that you have returned me to my disciples. Despite the unjust treatment I received, the confinement and ludicrous psychological assessments, I am willing to let bygones be bygones. As long as you leave me and my people alone, we can find a way to coexist. Space is very big after all.

texts.zh:
一连串地对天导弹从[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]表面升空，直接命中了我们高轨的观测站！观测站当场即遭摧毁，无人生还。

看来[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]地表上的文明正在以不可思议的速度迅猛发展——毫无疑问，这都是拜我们的叛变科学家所赐。我们已经不能把他们当做原始文明了，而且我们再也没机会将那位科学家从权力神坛上撵下来了。
texts.en:
Earlier today, a barrage of surface-to-space missiles was launched from the surface of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] at our observation post in high orbit! The station was destroyed with no survivors.

The civilization on the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface has advanced at an incredible rate - no doubt thanks to the efforts of our rogue scientist. We must now look upon them as a potential threat, and the window of opportunity to remove the scientist from power has been closed.

texts.zh:
[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上正在酝酿着紧张的局势。核战争迫在眉睫。如果我们什么都不做，他们就会毁灭自己。

我们是他们唯一的希望。
texts.en:
Tensions are brewing on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. Nuclear war looms. If we do nothing, they will destroy themselves.

We are their only hope.

label.zh: 没有必要再进行间谍活动了。
label.en: There's no further need for espionage.

texts.zh:
最近[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的几个大国之间爆发了一场大规模的战争。

我们的研究人员在安全的轨道上进行观察时，冲突迅速发展为在全球范围内进行相互核武投射。

[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的全部人口似乎都在核火中消亡，自然环境也遭到了巨大破坏。
texts.en:
A massive war was recently triggered between several of the largest nation states on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName].

While our researchers were observing safely from orbit, the conflict rapidly escalated into a global nuclear exchange.

The [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s entire population appears to have perished in the nuclear fire, and the environment has taken significant damage.

texts.en:
A massive war was recently triggered between several of the largest nation states on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName].

While our researchers were observing safely from orbit, the conflict rapidly escalated into a global nuclear exchange.

The [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat] has suffered extensive damage, with the destruction of every major city and more than 90% of the population. Scattered survivors have emerged from the rubble, but our researchers predict that the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s civilization will be regressing to a far less developed state.

[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]遭到了严重破坏，所有大型城市都被摧毁，90%的人口被消灭。零星的幸存者从废墟中出来，但我们的研究人员预测[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的文明将倒退至某个远不如当前的欠发达状态。
texts.en:
A massive war was recently triggered between several of the consciousnesses on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName].

While our researchers were observing safely from orbit, the conflict rapidly escalated into a global nuclear exchange.

The [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat] has suffered extensive damage, with the destruction of every major city and more than 90% of the population. Scattered survivors have emerged from the rubble, but our researchers predict that the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s civilization will be regressing to a far less developed state.
